notes.title: Madness is coming! On July 11th, Enelia is launching on Steam in Early Access!
notes.content:
[h2]Enelia: Dawn of Madness is launching on Steam on 11th of July!
[/h2]
Enelia invites you into a world of terrifying secrets and revelations hidden in the shadows of Nauris city. Madness takes on human forms, yet it seems no one pays attention. The hearts of Za'ani people are shrouded in darkness. Could this be the reason why love is forbidden?

Desperation brings you closer to charming but mysterious characters whose encounters spark feelings you've never experienced before. Each of them will lead you to answers, but only if you are ready for the truth. 

How far will you go to uncover the true nature of Madness?

[h2]What is expecting you?[/h2]

[h3]Enchanting Atmosphere of an Uncharted World[/h3]
Nauris is a world brimming with dark mysteries and ancient secrets. Embark on a journey through this fantastical realm, encountering mythical creatures, witnessing magical landscapes, and exploring its most enigmatic depths.

[h3]Cinematic Storytelling[/h3]
A visual novel that blends various storytelling styles—animated backgrounds, illustrations, dynamic comics, and cinematic cutscenes. Enelia is more than just a visual novel.

[h3]Romantic Arcs[/h3]
Three enigmatic male characters—Salar, Boone, and Elris—cannot hide their feelings, despite the prohibition. But are you ready to reciprocate and uncover their terrifying secrets?

[h3]Role-Playing Elements[/h3]
One Madness meter, two playable characters, and three shades of the Divine Voice lead you to over five endings and dozens of hidden storylines.

[h3]Astral Vision[/h3]
Madness lurks in the shadows, only emerging when it gains enough strength. Only astral vision can detect its presence and influence on the world and its people. Use astral vision to stare true madness in the face.

[h3]Extraordinary World[/h3]
The world of Nauris is unlike any you know—no cosmos, no planets, no moon, and no oceans. No one knows what lies beyond the Secret Expanse or what the Heart of the World, sought by every druid, truly is. And where did the Seilims, the majestic and mysterious mythical beings that govern the forces of nature, come from?


Forge a strong bond with a beloved character or become their sworn enemy, do good and maintain harmony or walk the path of darkness and plunge the world into chaos.

The choice is yours - follow the call of your heart or dive into the very heart of Madness?
